selectionPolicy.K: all finalized normalizedK / CKLine at window end
selectionPolicy.F: internal sealed confirmed F versus external CKLine.fx in {TOP, BOTTOM}
selectionPolicy.B: internal sealed strokes versus external CBi with is_sure=True (virtual/unsure excluded)
selectionPolicy.S: internal sealed confirmed Segments versus external CSeg with is_sure=True (partial geometry only; lifecycle NOT_COMPARABLE)

matchingDesign.objective: On each bipartite connected component: maximize cardinality, then maximize exact common-anchor pairs, then minimize sum of absolute anchor displacements. Accept only pairs forced across all optimal assignments.
